chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.topic: Multi-Step Conversion of Alkane to Alkyne
questions.question: What is the optimal multi-step synthetic sequence to convert 1-bromobutane into 1-butyne?

options.label: A
options.text: 1. NaOEt / EtOH, heat (E2 elimination to 1-butene) → 2. Br₂ in CH₂Cl₂ (dibromination to 1,2-dibromobutane) → 3. Excess NaNH₂ in liq. NH₃, then H₂O quench (double elimination to 1-butyne).

options.label: B
options.text: 1. Direct treatment with acetylene gas and NaOH.

questions.correct_answer: 1. NaOEt / EtOH, heat (E2 elimination to 1-butene) → 2. Br₂ in CH₂Cl₂ (dibromination to 1,2-dibromobutane) → 3. Excess NaNH₂ in liq. NH₃, then H₂O quench (double elimination to 1-butyne).
questions.explanation: E2 elimination generates the alkene; halogenation yields the vicinal dibromide; double dehydrohalogenation with excess strong base generates the terminal alkyne.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.question: What synthetic sequence converts 1-bromopropane into butanoic acid with a one-carbon extension?

options.label: C
options.text: 1. NaCN in DMSO (SN2 substitution to butanenitrile) → 2. Aqueous H₃O⁺, heat (acidic nitrile hydrolysis to butanoic acid).

questions.correct_answer: 1. NaCN in DMSO (SN2 substitution to butanenitrile) → 2. Aqueous H₃O⁺, heat (acidic nitrile hydrolysis to butanoic acid).
questions.explanation: Cyanide displacement adds one carbon via SN2; acidic hydrolysis converts the nitrile group to a carboxylic acid.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.question: What two-step sequence converts 2-bromopropane into 1-bromopropane?

options.label: A
options.text: 1. Potassium tert-butoxide (t-BuOK), 75°C (E2 elimination to propene) → 2. HBr with benzoyl peroxide (ROOR), hν (radical anti-Markovnikov hydrobromination).

questions.correct_answer: 1. Potassium tert-butoxide (t-BuOK), 75°C (E2 elimination to propene) → 2. HBr with benzoyl peroxide (ROOR), hν (radical anti-Markovnikov hydrobromination).
questions.explanation: Bulky base E2 yields propene; radical hydrobromination with peroxides delivers the anti-Markovnikov primary bromide.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.question: What two-step sequence converts cyclohexene into trans-cyclohexane-1,2-diol?

options.label: A
options.text: 1. mCPBA in CH₂Cl₂ (epoxidation to cyclohexene oxide) → 2. Aqueous H₃O⁺ / H₂O (acid-catalyzed anti ring opening).

questions.correct_answer: 1. mCPBA in CH₂Cl₂ (epoxidation to cyclohexene oxide) → 2. Aqueous H₃O⁺ / H₂O (acid-catalyzed anti ring opening).
questions.explanation: Epoxidation followed by acid-catalyzed nucleophilic ring opening by water enforces anti-stereospecific dihydroxylation.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.question: What single-step reagent converts cyclohexene into cis-cyclohexane-1,2-diol?

options.label: C
options.text: Osmium tetroxide with NMO in aqueous acetone (catalytic OsO₄ / NMO syn-dihydroxylation).

questions.correct_answer: Osmium tetroxide with NMO in aqueous acetone (catalytic OsO₄ / NMO syn-dihydroxylation).
questions.explanation: OsO₄ delivers two hydroxyl groups to the same face in a concerted syn-dihydroxylation.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.question: In the retrosynthetic analysis of 2-methyl-2-hexanol, which precursor pairing represents a valid disconnection?

options.label: B
options.text: 2-Pentanone + Methylmagnesium bromide (CH₃MgBr) followed by acidic workup.

questions.correct_answer: 2-Pentanone + Methylmagnesium bromide (CH₃MgBr) followed by acidic workup.
questions.explanation: Disconnection at the C-C bond adjacent to the 3° alcohol reveals 2-pentanone and methyl Grignard reagent.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.topic: Synthesis of Ketone from Terminal Alkyne
questions.question: What single-step reaction converts 1-pentyne into 2-pentanone?

options.label: A
options.text: Hydration with H₂O, catalytic H₂SO₄, and mercuric sulfate (HgSO₄) via Markovnikov enol tautomerization.

questions.correct_answer: Hydration with H₂O, catalytic H₂SO₄, and mercuric sulfate (HgSO₄) via Markovnikov enol tautomerization.
questions.explanation: Markovnikov hydration of a terminal alkyne catalyzed by Hg²⁺ yields a methyl ketone.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.topic: Synthesis of Aldehyde from Terminal Alkyne
questions.question: What two-step sequence converts 1-pentyne into pentanal (aldehyde)?

options.label: D
options.text: 1. Disiamylborane [(Sia)₂BH] in THF (anti-Markovnikov hydroboration) → 2. Basic hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂ / NaOH) oxidation.

questions.correct_answer: 1. Disiamylborane [(Sia)₂BH] in THF (anti-Markovnikov hydroboration) → 2. Basic hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂ / NaOH) oxidation.
questions.explanation: Anti-Markovnikov hydroboration with bulky dialkylborane followed by alkaline oxidation yields the aldehyde.

questions.chapter_title: A Review of General Chemistry: Electrons, Bonds, and Molecular Properties
questions.question: What three-step synthetic route converts 1-butene into 2-hexanone?

options.label: B
options.text: 1. HBr / ROOR, hν (anti-Markovnikov to 1-bromobutane) → 2. Sodium acetylide (NaC≡CH) in DMSO (alkynylation to 1-hexyne) → 3. H₂O, H₂SO₄, HgSO₄ (Markovnikov hydration to 2-hexanone).

questions.explanation: Anti-Markovnikov bromination, acetylide C-C alkylation, and mercury-catalyzed alkyne hydration constructs the 6-carbon ketone.

questions.topic: Aldehyde to Alkene via Wittig Reaction
